ASSIGNMENTANDASSUMPTIONOFAGREEMENTOFLEASE THIS ASSIGNMENT AND ASSUMPTION OF AGREEMENT OF LEASE,made as of the Qday of October, 2022, by Thor James Hotel Propco LLC and Thor James Hotel Investor LLC, each a Delaware limited liability company, each having an office at c/o Thor Equities LLC, 25 West 39th Street, 16th Floor, New York, New York 10018 (collectively, "Assignor"), , and Thor MHU Soho Hotel Propco Owner LLC and Thor MHU Soho Hotel Investor Owner LLC, each a Delaware limited liability company, each having an office at c/o Thor Equities LLC, 25 West 39th Street, 16th Floor, New York, New York 10018 (collectively, 'Assignce"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Assignor holds the right, title and interest as lessor in, to and under that certain Agreement of Lease, dated as of December 14, 2017, between Assignor, as landlord , and Thor James Hotel LeaseCo LLC, as tenant ("Tenant') (as amended through the date hereof, the "Lease"), a Memorandum of which was dated as of 12/14/2017 and recorded 12/28/2017 as CRFN 2017000473405, which Lease covers the premises described on Exhibit A attached hereto and made a part hereof (the “Premises") at the property located at 27 Grand Street, New York,NewYork; WHEREAS, Assignor desires to assign unto Assignee all of Assignor's right, title and interest as landlord in, to and under the Lease, and Assignee desires to succeed to the interest of Assignor, and to assume the obligations of Assignor under the Lease; and WHIEREAS, Tenant consents to the Assignment. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of Ten ($10.00) Dollars and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, 1. Assignor hereby assigns and transfers all of its right, title and interest as landlord in, to and under the Lease, to Assignee, its successors and permitted assigns, subject to the terms,covenants and conditions of the Lease. 2. Assignee hereby assumes the Lease and Assignor's obligations thereunder to the extent accruing from and after the date hereof. 3.1 Each of Assignor and Assignee agree to execute, acknowledge (where appropriate) and deliver such other or further instruments of transfer or assignment as the other party may reasonably require to confirm the foregoing assignment and assumption, or as may be otherwise reasonably requested by Assignee or Assignor to carry out the intent and purposes hereof. 4. Assignee hereby agrees to indemnify, protect, defend and hold Assignor harmless from and against any and all claims demands, liabilities, losses, costs, damages or expenses (including, without limitation, reasonable attorneys’ fees and costs) arising out of or {000263-228/00360140-8} 2

resulting from any breach or default by Assignee under the terms of the Lease arising on or after thedatehereof. 5.  This assignment shall include, without limitation, the interest of Assignor in any security deposit held by Assignor under the Lease, and in any interest or income earned thereon. 6. Tenant, by its execution hereof, acknowledges and agrees that it consents to the Assignment contemplated hereunder and recognizes Assignee as the landlord under the Lease. 7. This Assignment may not be modified, amended or terminated nor any of        n      s  8.  The covenants, agreements, terms, provisions and conditions contained in this Assignment shall be binding upon and inure to the benefit of the parties hereto and their respective successors and assigns. It is further agreed by the parties that this assignment shall constitute a mere change in the form of ownership of the holder of the rights of the landlord under the Lease. This Assignment may be executed in identical counterparts, each of which shall be an original and all of which together shall constitute one instrument. 10. Assignor, in compliance with Section 13 of the Lien Law of the State of New York, covenants that Assignor will receive the consideration for this Assignment and will hold the right to receive such consideration as a trust fund to be applied first for the purpose of paying the cost of the improvement and will apply the same first to the payment of this cost of the improvement before using any part of the total of the same for any other purpose. {000263-228/00360140-8} 3

Assumption of Operating Lease the date first above set forth.
